summary:
Turn 14 reviewed the second artifact and caught a real correspondence defect in it instead of letting an unreviewed violation stand.

State on entry. The first artifact for C1-recovery-adopts-committed-vector is confirmed in scope (violated, reviewed, no open issues). The second artifact (d087e4751b254280bc7cc68779e5082e, executed as d5769994f11746fba640e2057fbd13b8) also reported violated but was unreviewed, so the review contract for checker_correspondence was open.

Finding of the review (revision_needed, challenged component: observation). The added accept-round property does not observe the round it is meant to judge. After the resolution, handlePrepareReply takes sub-case 6 and calls startPhase1, which replaces the record and queues a PreAccept, not an Accept. The harness drains that PreAccept into the committed replica, whose handlePreAccept status >= ACCEPTED branch replies with Status COMMITTED, and delivering that PreAcceptReply is what moves the recoverer to ACCEPTED and queues the Accept (visible only in the trailing diagnostic event's out_codes). So at the moment the accept_round_after_commit event is emitted, the accept reply has neither been produced nor delivered: accept_oks_before/after 0 to 0 reflects the phase-1 reply, and instance_status_after ACCEPTED records the PreAcceptReply transition rather than a completed accept attempt. The predicate therefore cannot establish or refute the continuation question, and the violation is an artefact of the schedule plus reading acceptOKs at the wrong point. The repair is named in the item: drain and assert the queued message codes as a control, deliver the Accept to the committed replica and its AcceptReply back, and read acceptOKs and the record status from the record currently in InstanceSpace. Counterevidence is cited from the retained stream and the handlers, and lim
itations keep the first property's review unchanged and the consequence question open.

Effect. The consequence question (whether a non-adopting recovery can complete, and whether the row then stalls) stays open rather than being promoted; the confirmed adoption finding is untouched; and the earlier decided results and map basis (v4) are unchanged. No requirement, premise or prior observation was weakened.
